claim: Explicit evidence files were path-exempted without an enforced content hash.
evidence: Changing the verify run configuration after artifact creation did not fail check-records.
impact: Reviewed configuration and the configuration used for verification could diverge.
required_action: Require an evidence_hashes digest for every exact evidence file and reject mismatches.

prevention.action: Bind evidence_files to evidence_hashes in Artifact identity and verify worktree content.
